name: timetravel
description: Time Travel tour engine: batch pipeline, tour API, and mobile playground

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/schema packages/client apps/api apps/pipeline apps/playground
scripts.test: node tools/check-vendored-client.cjs && node tools/check-css-collisions.cjs && npm run test -w @timetravel/schema && npm run test -w @timetravel/client && npm run test -w @timetravel/api && npm run test -w @timetravel/pipeline
scripts.build: npm run build:player && npm run build:api
